title: ViSSFlow: Unifying Video-Conditioned Sound and Speech Generation via Joint Learning
abstract: arXiv:2509.24773v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video-conditioned audio generation, including Video-to-Sound (V2S) and Visual Text-to-Speech (VisualTTS), has traditionally been studied as two separate tasks despite their shared objective of generating audio conditioned on visual content. Existing methods rely on task-specific architectures and training paradigms, while the possibility of a unified generative framework remains largely unexplored due to heterogeneous conditioning signals and limited joint training data. In this paper, we propose ViSSFlow, a unified flow-matching framework for both V2S and VisualTTS. To effectively integrate diverse conditioning modalities within a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), we introduce a disentangled condition aggregation mechanism that exploits the complementary roles of attention layers, using cross-attention to model semantic conditions and self-attention to capture temporally dense visual cues. translated_title: ViSSFlow：通过联合学习统一视频条件下的声音与语音生成
translated_abstract: 视频条件下的音频生成，包括视频生成声音和视觉文本转语音，尽管有着基于视觉内容生成音频的共同目标，但传统上一直被作为两个独立的任务来研究。现有方法依赖于任务特定的架构和训练范式，而由于条件信号的异质性以及有限的联合训练数据，统一生成框架的可能性在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们提出了 ViSSFlow，一个面向 V2S 和 VisualTTS 两种任务的统一流匹配框架。为了在扩散 Transformer（DiT）中有效整合多样化的条件模态，我们引入了一种解耦的条件聚合机制，利用注意力层的互补作用：使用交叉注意力来建模语义条件，并使用自注意力来捕获时间上密集的视觉线索。此外，与普遍假设相反……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出统一的流匹配框架 ViSSFlow，通过解耦的条件聚合机制（交叉注意力建模语义条件、自注意力捕获时序密集的视觉线索），将视频生成声音与视觉文本转语音两项任务统一在同一生成式框架下进行联合学习。
en_tdlr: ViSSFlow is a unified flow-matching framework that jointly performs video-to-sound generation and visual text-to-speech by leveraging a disentangled condition aggregation mechanism—cross-attention for semantic conditions and self-attention for temporally dense visual cues—within a Diffusion Transformer.
